probes.title: IME native commit
probes.action: Compose 日本語, choose native candidate and commit; type X.
probes.expected: Exactly committed 日本語X in the target paragraph, one declared composition undo group, caret after X; capture provisional and committed text.

probes.title: IME cancel/focus race
probes.initial: Chinese IME in a task page body.
probes.action: Start composition, open/dismiss a toolbar, cancel composition and type X.
probes.expected: Native commit/cancel behaviour recorded; only accepted text persists, no task/title command runs from candidate Enter, X goes to intended focused body.

probes.title: Korean table composition
probes.initial: Korean input source; empty selected table cell.
probes.action: Compose 한글, accept then undo/redo through native menu.
probes.expected: Content stays inside the cell; no duplicate characters, focus theft or independent nested undo stack.

probes.title: Dead key and grapheme
probes.action: Enter a dead-key accent sequence, then delete once at the declared grapheme boundary.
probes.expected: Composed accent applied once; no invalid surrogate/cluster split or stale selection.

probes.title: Native spelling replacement
probes.initial: Synthetic misspelled word in paragraph with backward range elsewhere.
probes.action: Use native spelling correction on the misspelling then undo.
probes.expected: Only targeted word replaced once; undo restores it, unrelated range/content unchanged.

probes.title: Paste and match style
probes.initial: Rich text clipboard with safe bold/link and plain text.
probes.action: Invoke native Paste and Match Style, then undo/redo.
probes.expected: Plain textual content at selected range, no retained foreign formatting or shared task identity; one grouped paste.

probes.title: VoiceOver route
probes.initial: Task, table, toolbar and read-only embed fixtures.
probes.action: Navigate and activate each with VoiceOver; escape nested controls.
probes.expected: Names/roles/state and finite focus path; same domain result as equivalent pointer action, embed remains read-only.

probes.title: Intentional focus beats pending restore
probes.initial: Toolbar formatting started in view A.
probes.action: Focus view B before asynchronous toolbar completion.
probes.expected: Formatting applies only to captured valid A context or safely refuses; focus stays intentionally in B.

probes.title: Two origins overlapping text
probes.initial: A and B share Alpha beta.
probes.action: A replaces beta with gamma; B attempts stale overlapping replacement and then undo.
probes.expected: Serialize/map or refuse under explicit protocol; preserve B provisional input, no silent lost edits; B undo cannot remove A-only work. Exact successful mapping depends on PL-04.

probes.title: Dirty composition and provider winner
probes.initial: View A has active IME and an incoming winning snapshot.
probes.action: Deliver winner before composition resolves; resolve input and reopen history.
probes.expected: Protect provisional input before replacement; explicit Q-07 boundary and retained states, no dropped candidate text or false local undo of remote change.

probes.title: Native drop with save failure
probes.initial: Image/PDF fixture and active paragraph selection.
probes.action: Native drop asset; fail staging/save; close then restart.
probes.expected: No complete reference to missing bytes, no unprotected text loss, honest pending/failure and recovery.

probes.title: Keyboard layout and shortcut collision
probes.initial: Two OS input sources and native menu routes.
probes.action: Repeat movement/extension/undo/redo and a non-Latin input shortcut.
probes.expected: Actual physical and logical key recorded; typing is not stolen by global shortcut, focused context receives native commands.

probes.title: Dictation capability probe
probes.initial: OS dictation enabled in a synthetic paragraph.
probes.action: Dictate a phrase, finish, replace a selected word and undo.
probes.expected: Supported path targets intended content once; otherwise explicit capability decision and blocking reason recorded.

probes.title: Same-range in-flight refusal
probes.initial: Authority has rejected a pending edit after view typed more text.
probes.action: Delay rejection, type further text, deliver rejection then reconnect.
probes.expected: Recover both pending sequences with correct base/origin; no rollback discards later provisional typing.

probes.title: Native line convention
probes.action: Use Home/End/Fn variants and declared line-start/end chords; immediately type X and undo.
probes.expected: Result follows declared native caret-versus-scroll action; X targets actual intended caret, no transient stale range.

probes.title: Multi-step stress and recovery
probes.initial: Typical fixture, two views and deterministic seed 7306.
probes.action: Run 1000 logged valid edits/navigation/focus/history actions; fail save at action 500, protect and restart after action 750.
probes.expected: Replay is reproducible; identity/selection/history invariants hold or minimal failing trace retained; no unsaved text loss.
